clues: This city stands in the far north of Russia. It lies east of the Yenisey River, south of the Taymyr Peninsula.
This city sits in a zone of permafrost, where the ground stays frozen and cold all year. It is one of just two large cities on such ground.
Soviet leaders said yes to its big plant in nineteen thirty-five, and it was done by nineteen thirty-nine. Then the mines grew fast.
This city sits right on top of some of the largest nickel deposits on Earth. Digging and melting that ore is its main work.
No city in the world this far north holds so many people. It sits inside the Arctic Circle, in the far north.
